productName: Addison Crib with Raised Panel Headboard
description: Make a bold, beautiful statement in the nursery with the Addison Crib featuring a raised panel headboard. This 4-in-1 convertible crib offers the same solid hardwood construction and Brown Maple finish as the classic Addison, elevated by a stunning raised panel design that adds architectural depth and sophistication to your little one's room. Transition seamlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed as your child grows — a single investment that serves your family for years. Three adjustable mattress height settings provide flexibility and safety from newborn to toddler. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials and rigorously tested to exceed CPSC and ASTM standards, this crib gives you style without compromise. Pair with the full Addison collection for a coordinated look that flows beautifully from nursery to big-kid room.
